title: Hypno Steals the Dreams It Likes Best
premise: Hypno puts hungry humans to sleep, tastes their dreams, and carries away anyone having a good one.
audiencePromise: Follow Hypno from hunger and hypnosis to its unsettling dream-stealing rule.
openLoop: Why does Hypno carry away only people having good dreams?
payoff: Hypno's worst hunger turns sleep into a hunt for the dreams it likes best.
engagementQuestion: Would you risk sleep, or guard your best dreams?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and uneasy. Sound like a knowledgeable fan revealing something creepy. Stress hunger, good, and carried away. Pause briefly before each reveal.

scenes.headline: GOOD DREAMS AREN'T SAFE
scenes.narration: Hypno makes people sleep, then steals the good dreams.
scenes.caption: SLEEP IS ONLY THE FIRST STEP

scenes.headline: HUNGER STARTS THE HUNT
scenes.narration: When hunger hits, it puts humans it meets to sleep.
scenes.caption: VERY HUNGRY HYPNO

scenes.headline: THE PENDULUM OPENS THE DOOR
scenes.narration: Its steady pendulum causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
scenes.caption: ANYONE NEARBY GETS DROWSY

scenes.headline: DREAMS BECOME FOOD
scenes.narration: Then it feasts on those dreams, turning sleep into its meal.
scenes.caption: HYPNO TASTES YOUR DREAMS

scenes.headline: PEOPLE WITH GOOD DREAMS
scenes.narration: But anyone having a good dream gets carried away by Hypno.
scenes.caption: PEOPLE WITH GOOD DREAMS GET CARRIED OFF

scenes.headline: GUARD YOUR DREAMS
scenes.narration: Would you risk sleep, or guard your best dreams?
scenes.caption: SLEEP PEACEFULLY OR STAY ALERT?
